CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 28, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  5:59 P.M. in City Hall Conference Room A

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Planning Manager; Kari Fowler, City Historic Preservation
  Planner

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – October 22, 2025
    Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the October 22, 2025,
  Regular Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation
  Commission.
    Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the October 22, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
  MOTION:
    Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
    Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Chen.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  COMMEMORATIVE HISTORIC PLAQUE PROGRAM
    This is a presentation on the proposed template plaque design for
  a Commemorative Historic Plaque Program.

  1
  1/28/2026
     Recommended Action: It is recommended the Historic
  Preservation Commission receive the presentation on the template
  plaque design presented by City staff; receive public comment;
  review the proposed plaque design; and provide a recommendation
  to the City Council on a plaque design for the proposed
  Commemorative Historic Plaque Program.
    City Historic Preservation Planner Kari Fowler provided the Staff
  presentation.
    The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was
  opened and then closed.
    Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng

  MOTION:
    Moved to recommend City Council to adopt the plaque design
  template per Staff’s presentation with the following design details:
  o Size: 8”x10” horizontal;
  o Metal: Bronze;
  o Color: Brown;
  o Background texture: Leatherette;
  o Border: Double line bevel;
  o Font: Times New Roman;
  o Mount Type: Blind mount.
  Plaque not to include a designation date or restoration date. If a
  property is designated as both a Historic Landmark and a
  contributor to a Historic District, a plaque may indicate both.
    Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Ng.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

    There were no public hearing items.

G.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

    Marlene B. asked how properties got onto the survey list and if it’s too late to be
  added as historic, noting her interest in options for a property to be considered
  historic by the City and to become a Landmark. President Amaro and Planning
  Manager Maia McCurley directed her to the City’s Historic Preservation website for
  information about the Survey, Ordinance, and historic designation process.

H.  ADJOURNMENT:

    There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:34 P.M. to
  Wednesday, February 25, 2026 at 6:00 P.M.

  1/28/2026

  Dylan Littlefield
